text: 金十数据11月13日讯，芝加哥联储主席古尔斯比周五在接受CNBC采访时表示，即使油价迅速下跌，炼油能力依然“存在问题”，这将使柴油和航空燃油价格维持高位。他表示，通胀目前正向那些价格并非由能源成本上涨驱动的类别蔓延，如果需求过热，美联储就无法对通胀视而不见。古尔斯比认为数据中心正在推高物价，而服务通胀和不断上涨的医疗成本给人的感觉绝对是短期内不会迅速回落。古尔斯比补充说，目前美联储并未走在实现2%通胀目标的轨道上，央行需要应对这一问题以确保需求不会过热；如果数据表明通胀正在恶化，这将促使美联储在政策上采取更激进的行动。
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 13 - Chicago Fed President Goolsbee said in a CNBC interview on Friday that even if oil prices fall rapidly, refining capacity still "has problems," which will keep diesel and jet fuel prices high. He said inflation is now spreading to categories whose prices are not driven by rising energy costs, and if demand overheats, the Fed cannot turn a blind eye to inflation. Goolsbee believes data centers are pushing up prices, while services inflation and rising medical costs absolutely feel like they will not fall quickly in the short term. Goolsbee added that the Fed is currently not on track to achieve its 2% inflation target, and the central bank needs to address this to ensure demand does not overheat; if data show inflation is worsening, that would prompt the Fed to take more aggressive policy action.
